questions.stem_text:
In the last 20 years firms that produce cameras have begun to produce fewer 35-mm cameras
and more digital cameras. This trend is an example of

options.A: the market system answering the question of "what" cameras should be produced.
options.B: the market system answering the question of "when" cameras should be produced.
options.C: the market system answering the question of "why" cameras should be produced.
options.D: the influence of government regulation on camera production.
options.E: the market system answering the question of "where" cameras should be produced.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the market system answering the question of "what" cameras should be produced.

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following statements is true concerning the population regression function
(PRF) and sample regression function (SRF)?

options.A: The PRF and SRF are interchangeable terms referring to the same concept.
options.B: The PRF is the model used for prediction, while the SRF is used for explanation
options.C: The PRF is used to infer likely values of the SRF
options.D: Whether the model is good can be determined by comparing the SRF and the PRF
options.E: The SRF is a theoretical construct, while the PRF is an empirical construct

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The PRF and SRF are interchangeable terms referring to the same concept.

questions.stem_text:
If corn is produced in a perfectly competitive market and the government placed a price
ceiling above equilibrium, which of the following would be true?

options.A: Corn would become a luxury good due to the price ceiling.
options.B: The government would have to subsidize corn production.
options.C: The price of corn would increase dramatically.
options.D: The price of corn would remain the same but the quality would decrease.
options.E: The producers of corn would lose revenue due to the decreased price.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Corn would become a luxury good due to the price ceiling.

questions.stem_text: What is meant by the technically efficient methodof production?

options.A: A method that minimizes the time taken to produce a product
options.B: A method that uses more of all inputs to increase output
options.C: A method that produces the highest quantity of output
options.D: A method that relies solely on the latest technology
options.E: A method that achieves the fastest production speed regardless of resource usage

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - A method that minimizes the time taken to produce a product
